sources: sizes: the hotel's own capacity chart (https://courtlandgrandhotel.com/floor-plan-capacity-charts/, read 2026-10-03). The chart gives each room's area and not its sides: the sides are the whole feet whose product is the chart's area and whose shape is the plan's

placement, order and orientation: the hotel's own floor plan, reference/plans/courtland-grand-site-2024-level-2.webp, the picture of level 2 on the same page (2436 x 1830 px), measured from the two banks of elevators it draws (DECISIONS #28: read for position only, nothing copied)
which rooms the con uses, what it calls them and which way is north: Dragon Con's 2026 map, reference/dragoncon/ (read only)
notes: the lobby floor: the front drive and the Courtland Street entrance at the north-west, the lobby east of it, and the meeting rooms in a row down the west side of the Cities Hallway

Athens, Augusta and Macon run north to south, 39, 28 and 28 ft, on one 44 ft depth. Valdosta, 27 ft, ends the row south of Macon; it is on the plan, is not a room of the venues file and had no 2026 programming, so it is not drawn

the Cities Hallway and the Lobby are drawn by eye. The hallway is drawn its whole length, so it runs 27 ft past Macon with nothing beside it: Valdosta is there. The Savannah rooms, south-east of the hallway, are on the plan and not in the venues file
the plan is measured from the two banks of elevators all three floors' plans draw. At that scale it draws the row, Valdosta with it, 44.0 x 122.0 ft against the chart's 44 x 122
